observations.command:
set -eu
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
for key in busnum devnum idVendor idProduct bcdDevice authorized bConfigurationValue power/runtime_status; do printf '%s=' "$key"; cat "/sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/$key"; done
for n in 0 1 2; do if test -L /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.$n/driver; then printf 'BOUND_%s=' "$n"; readlink /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1:1.$n/driver; else printf 'UNBOUND_%s
' "$n"; fi; done
bus=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/busnum)
num=$(cat /sys/bus/usb/devices/7-1/devnum)
node=$(printf '/dev/bus/usb/%03d/%03d' "$bus" "$num")
count=0
for fd in /proc/[0-9]*/fd/*; do link=$(readlink "$fd" 2>/dev/null) || continue; if test "$link" = "$node"; then echo "USB_FD_HOLDER=$fd"; count=$((count+1)); fi; done
printf 'USB_FD_HOLDERS=%s
' "$count"
cat /proc/uptime
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo OWNER_PAIRED_POST_HOST_METADATA_COMPLETE
